pages.text: Choose a wooden or upholstered driver’s seat; either accepts a cabinet.$(br2)Standard and extended boxes use single or double seats. Wide boxes also accept triples. Drive from the left of a double bench or the middle of a triple; other positions carry passengers.

Use the $(bold)visible upper cushion or wooden seat surface$(reset) to board, with sufficient rider clearance.$(br2)Craft double benches from matching singles. Craft triples from three singles or a double and a single, all of matching wood.

Both shaft types fit every box. Craft double-horse shafts from two single sets. Before departure, fill the single hitch or both double-hitch positions.$(br2)Shafts use a fixed wooden appearance. Choose a type according to the number of draft animals you want to use.
